turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, a little stressed, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've seen a few apartments and I need to choose one before Friday.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll tell you all the choices first. Wait until I'm finished before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One is a bright two bedroom near the train station, but the rent is at the top of my budget.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is a cheaper place in a quiet neighborhood, but it's a forty minute bus ride to work.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or there's a small studio right downtown with a gym in the building and no parking.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's all I've got. Which would you choose?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The two bedroom near the station gives you space and an easy commute, if you can handle the rent. The cheaper place saves money but that long bus ride adds up every day. The studio is great for city life if you don't own a car.
